tools.name: shoprocket_get_store
tools.description: The Shoprocket store this key belongs to: name, address, environment (test or live), paused state, currencies and languages, setup status. The store's API keys are never returned. GET /v1/store/details.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_store_stats
tools.description: Sales statistics for a date range, compared with the previous period: orders, revenue, visitors, abandoned carts, conversion rate, average order value, a daily sales graph, regions, sources and popular products. GET /v1/store/stats.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_orders
tools.description: List or search orders with totals, customer, addresses, payment and fulfillment status, discounts, line items and shipping. Filter by payment status, fulfillment status, payment method, customer ids, amount range, sale/discount use or free text. GET /v1/orders.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_order
tools.description: One order by id (ord_..., not the #number shown in the dashboard): totals, customer, billing and shipping address, payment and fulfillment status, discounts, line items and tracking. GET /v1/orders/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_order_status
tools.description: WRITE: change an order's payment status and/or fulfillment status (for example mark it shipped or paid). Shoprocket needs both values, so a value you leave out is read from the order first and kept. With send_email true Shoprocket EMAILS THE CUSTOMER an order update (optionally with custom_text); th

tools.name: shoprocket_list_products
tools.description: List products with price, SKU, stock quantity, categories, images, variants (skus) and status. Search by text, filter by category slugs, product ids or slugs, and sort. GET /v1/products.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_product
tools.description: One product by id (prod_...): description, price, SKU, stock, dimensions, categories, media, variants (skus), add-ons. GET /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_product
tools.description: WRITE: create a product in the store (visible to shoppers unless status is 0). A name and at least one category (name or slug) are required. Does not create duplicates by itself: calling twice creates two products. Variants and add-ons are not set by this tool. PUT /v1/products.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_product
tools.description: WRITE: change a product's fields (price, stock quantity, description, status...). Shoprocket requires the name on every update, so pass the current name to keep it. Only the fields you pass are sent. POST /v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_categories
tools.description: List product categories with id, name and slug. GET /v1/categories.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_category
tools.description: One category by id (cat_...); with expand_products also the products in it. GET /v1/categories/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_category
tools.description: WRITE: create a product category (optionally assigning existing products). Calling twice with the same name may create a duplicate or be refused by Shoprocket. PUT /v1/categories.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_category
tools.description: WRITE: rename a category, change its slug, or set the products in it. Only the fields you pass are sent. POST /v1/categories/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_customers
tools.description: List customers with name, email, phone, company, tax number, country and marketing opt-in. GET /v1/customers.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_customer
tools.description: One customer by id (cus_...). GET /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_customer
tools.description: WRITE: add a customer record (it does not email the customer). marketing_subscribed records newsletter consent: set it to true only if the customer actually opted in. PUT /v1/customers.

tools.name: shoprocket_update_customer
tools.description: WRITE: change a customer's email, name, phone, company, tax number or newsletter consent. Only the fields you pass are sent. Set marketing_subscribed true only if the customer actually opted in. POST /v1/customers/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_discount_codes
tools.description: List discount codes with type, value, what they apply to, usage limit and count, minimum order, dates and status. GET /v1/discount-codes.

tools.name: shoprocket_get_discount_code
tools.description: One discount code by id (ofr_...). GET /v1/discount-codes/{id}.

tools.name: shoprocket_create_discount_code
tools.description: WRITE: create a live discount code that shoppers can use at checkout and that reduces the store's revenue. Type fixed or percentage needs coupon_value; free_shipping does not. Use usage_limit and dates to bound it. Calling twice creates two codes. PUT /v1/discount-codes.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_automatic_discounts
tools.description: List automatic discounts (applied at checkout without a code) with type, value, conditions, dates and status. GET /v1/automatic-discounts.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_sales
tools.description: List sale promotions (price reductions on products) with type, value, what they apply to, dates and status. GET /v1/sale-promotions.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_shipping_methods
tools.description: List the store's shipping methods and rates. GET /v1/shippings.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_taxes
tools.description: List the store's tax rules. GET /v1/taxes.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_zones
tools.description: List the store's shipping zones (the regions it ships to). GET /v1/zones.

tools.name: shoprocket_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List the store's payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, manual...) and whether they are enabled. Gateway credentials are never returned. GET /v1/payment-methods.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "shoprocket_list_payment_methods" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: List the store's payment gateways (Stripe, PayPal, manual...) and whether they are enabled. Gateway credentials are never returned. GET /v1/payment-methods.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: shoprocket_update_order_status, shoprocket_list_customers · Private data: shoprocket_get_store, shoprocket_create_customer, shoprocket_list_payment_methods · Public sink: shoprocket_update_order_status, shoprocket_update_product, shoprocket_update_category, shoprocket_list_customers, shoprocket_create_customer, shoprocket_update_customer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: shoprocket_update_order_status, shoprocket_list_customers · Private data: shoprocket_get_store, shoprocket_create_customer, shoprocket_list_payment_methods · Public sink: shoprocket_update_order_status, shoprocket_update_product, shoprocket_update_category, shoprocket_list_customers, shoprocket_create_customer, shoprocket_update_customer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
